purpose: Estimate route redistribution after a user-confirmed disruption using the strongest supported assignment tier.

primary_sources.citation: Wardrop (1952), Some theoretical aspects of road traffic research
Beckmann, McGuire and Winsten (1956), Studies in the Economics of Transportation
U.S. Bureau of Public Roads (1964), Traffic Assignment Manual

known_limitations: Proxy OD anchors are a sensitivity design, not recovered travel demand.
BPR alpha and beta are disclosed defaults unless calibrated externally.
No live traffic-control action is produced.
